##### Project general facts

Eighth Sense is a boutique residential project located just three minutes from Bali’s iconic Pandawa Beach. Developed with meticulous attention to detail, the complex features a curated collection of one-bedroom apartments, two-bedroom apartments with private rooftops, and one-bedroom villas with rooftop terraces. Each unit is designed to awaken the senses, offering a tranquil atmosphere where every detail reveals feelings in a new way.

Residents and guests enjoy a wealth of premium facilities, including a 24/7 reception and concierge service, a spa area with massage rooms, an infinity pool with sunset views, and a restaurant serving European cuisine with delivery service. A summer café, ice bath, yoga platform, Starlink high-speed internet, parking, and art zones for leisurely strolls complete the offering. Free shuttle services provide convenient transport to the best beaches in the area.

Every interior at Eighth Sense is thoughtfully crafted to create an atmosphere of complete relaxation and comfort. The design concept blends modern aesthetics with natural textures, using certified materials and high-quality finishes throughout. Apartments feature open-plan layouts, while villas offer spacious living areas and private rooftop terraces. Kitchens are fully equipped, and bathrooms showcase premium fixtures. The project is built with official construction permits, concrete quality testing, and rigorous technical supervision.

 ##### Parking
Shared parking.

 ##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the prestigious Pandawa area of South Bali, this exceptional location places residents just moments from one of the island’s most stunning white-sand beaches. Pandawa Beach is renowned for its dramatic limestone cliffs, crystal-clear waters, and calm swimming conditions, making it a favorite among families and travelers seeking natural beauty. The area offers easy access to world-famous surf breaks, luxury resorts, and cultural landmarks.

The location is distinguished by its strategic convenience and wealth of nearby activities. Ngurah Rai International Airport is within easy reach, while the bustling hubs of Nusa Dua and Uluwatu are just a short drive away. Guests can enjoy professional surfing, parasailing, snorkeling, yacht trips, and the nearby Bukit Pandawa Golf & Country Club, as well as the GWK Cultural Park, all within minutes.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal elegance, adventure, and tranquility, the Pandawa area delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of pristine beaches, world-class golf, cultural attractions, and easy access to Bali’s finest offerings makes it one of the island’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, inspiring and effortlessly connected.
